badge.line: Thirty-five years old, wearing his badge
stanza: With a borderline joke to the guys at the bar
And they slap their knees like they've not heard it before
Thirty-five years old, wearing his badge
Nickname for life on the shoulder of his bomber
That he wears as the coach of the high school team

badge.line: Well I was walking down the street with my shiny badge
stanza: Well I was walking down the street with my shiny badge
My spurs jingling there at my feet
I seen a man a-coming, coming with a gun
And I just can't be beat
